a: Yes, on iPhone and iPad, on Android and in your browser. Ads keep it free: a small banner, an ad now and then between levels, and videos you can choose to watch for a reward. The shop sells coin packs and Remove Ads, but every level can be won without paying.

Tap an arrow and it slides off the board, but only if nothing is in its way. Clear every arrow to win. Each arrow you clear can only free others, so a level never becomes impossible. Start with arrows whose path to the edge is already empty. How to play has the rest.

q: What happens when I run out of hearts?
a: You start every level with three hearts, and tapping a blocked arrow costs one. Out of hearts, you can continue once with 100 coins for three hearts, or on Android watch a video for full hearts. Or tap Retry and start the level again. A run with a continue doesn't go on the leaderboard.

600, in 17 worlds from the Meadow to Starlight, harder all the way, with a hard level every 10th. A new obstacle arrives every 20 to 30 levels, each on an easy level built to teach it. Boards come in 49 shapes and grow up to 100 cells a side.

Yes: The Tangled Tower. Prince Arlo and Pip the owl climb the Tower of Worlds to break the Duskweaver's curse, told in 81 painted pages with their own music. A world's pages play over the map when you reach it and when you free its guardian, and you can read the whole storybook here too, chapter by chapter as you unlock them.

The boss of each world, on its last level, from Bramble the hedgehog on level 20 to the Duskweaver on level 500. Arrows that fly out of the top of the board hit the guardian, and the last hit frees it, before the curse clock runs out. Most guardians hold a shield that moves every few hits. The wiki explains every trick.

q: Can I play without installing it?
a: Yes: play Exitwise in your browser, on a computer, a tablet or an iPhone. To install the app, download it from the App Store on iPhone and iPad, or get it from Google Play on Android.

q: Is Exitwise on iPhone and iPad?
a: Yes: Exitwise is free on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. It isn't in the EU App Stores yet: until it is, join the iPhone beta on TestFlight. In the app you sign in with Apple, and your progress is kept with your free VGraphics account (VHub). If you play in the browser with Google, link your Apple ID to that same account on the VHub page, and your progress comes along to the app. You can also play it free in Safari at vgraphics.gr/exitwise/play/.

On Android, yes: the levels are on your phone, so you can play on the commute or on a plane. Your results wait on the phone and reach the leaderboards the next time you're online. Rooms, other players' maps and the global ranking need a connection.

q: How do I keep my progress on a new phone, or in the browser?
a: Sign in to VHub, the free VGraphics account: tap the VHub button at the top right of the map, or Sign in on the account card in Settings. On Android and in the browser you sign in with Google, and on iPhone and iPad with Apple; on vgraphics.gr you can also sign in with Apple on the VHub page, and the game in your browser then uses that account too. If you play with Google, link your Apple ID to that same VHub account on the VHub page (or Google to your Apple account), and either one opens it. The first time you sign in from the game, you get 100 coins. Once you are in, that button shows your VHub picture and opens your profile. Your saved game is kept in the cloud, so you can carry on from another phone or in your browser, signed in to the same account. Without signing in, your progress stays on the device.

q: How do coins and hints work?
a: Every level pays 10 coins, a hard level 30, and a perfect clear 5 more. The daily challenge and other players' maps pay too. Spend coins on hints, a continue or powerups. You get 3 free hints; after that a hint costs 30 coins, or on Android a short video.

q: What can I buy, and do I keep it on a new phone?
a: The shop sells four coin packs, from 300 coins for €0.99 to 5,000 for €9.99, and Remove Ads, which takes away the banner and the video every 10 levels. You pay through Google Play on Android and through the App Store on iPhone and iPad, and we never see your payment details. Bought coins never expire. They are saved with your game, so sign in to keep them on every device. Remove Ads comes back by itself on Android; on iPhone and iPad, open Settings and tap Restore purchases.

q: How do I play with friends?
a: Open Play with friends and create a room: you get a 6-character code. 2 to 8 players join by typing it, scanning the invite's QR code or opening its link, in the app or in the browser. Everyone races on the same boards, and the fastest clear scores the most. More about rooms.

q: How do I add a friend?
a: Tap a player on any leaderboard, the global boards, a map's creator, a room or your match history, then Add friend on their profile. They get your request on VHub and in their notifications, and once they accept you are friends in every VGraphics game. You can also add friends by name or friend code on VHub. On a profile, sign in first; as a guest you can still add friends by friend code on VHub.

q: How do I delete my data?
a: In Settings, tap your account card to open your profile: "Delete my Exitwise data" there takes you off the boards and removes your results, stats, cloud save and published maps, and what you earned in Exitwise on VHub; your VGraphics name and picture stay. "Delete my VGraphics account", in the small print at the foot of Settings, removes your account in every VGraphics game, name and picture too; it asks for a second tap first. Either way the progress on your device stays. The privacy policy has the details.

q: How do I report a problem or share an idea?
a: In the game, open Settings and switch to its Help and news tab, then tap New ticket: say what happened or what you'd like, add a screenshot of the game if you want, and send it. Your tickets and our answers are listed on that tab, with a red dot on Help and news when one is waiting, and come by email too if you ask. Exitwise's news by email, one email a month at most, is a switch on the same tab. Help & ideas in Settings' Play section takes you to that tab in one tap, and on Android and iPhone, Rate us beside it opens the store so you can rate Exitwise. On this site, use Help at the foot of any page.

q: Do my settings follow me to my other devices?
a: Yes, once you sign in to VHub, the free VGraphics account. Music, sounds, vibration, tap twice to launch and the story pages follow you to every phone and PC you play on, and you can change them from your VHub picture at the top right of this site too. Without an account they stay on the device. How loud the game plays stays with each device.
